name: pair_frequency
note: complementary and conflicting pair on frequency

name: pair_transient
note: complementary and conflicting pair on transient

name: pair_tonal
note: complementary and conflicting pair on tonal; the conflicting judgment is 0.65 away and is reported

name: pair_texture
note: complementary and conflicting pair on the Jev-only texture dimension

name: pair_arrangement
note: complementary and conflicting pair on the Jev-only arrangement dimension

name: dimension_states
note: all four states of frequency in one run: judgment only, both sources, DSP only with an explicit unavailable entry, neither

name: abstention
note: a null-label model_abstained judgment is provenance, never a score

name: transport_states
note: every #14 transport or question outcome code is recorded verbatim and never becomes a score

name: mixed_batch
note: one candidate with judgments and one without: exact order, per-candidate confidence and provenance

name: total_unavailability
note: no usable judgment anywhere gives the dsp-only fallback, equal to rank_candidates at runtime

name: total_unavailability_with_codes
note: upstream codes and an abstention are recorded, yet the records stay the baseline's own

name: rhythmic_absent
note: the control for the rhythmic fixture: no rhythmic evidence at all

name: rhythmic_present
note: a supplied rhythmic judgment is unweighted: it changes no score, order or alternative

name: tie_exact_equal
note: two candidates whose combined compatibility is exactly equal, declared in reverse order

name: tie_dsp_only_vs_jev_only
note: an exact tie between a DSP-only candidate and a Jev-only candidate, broken by ID alone

name: custom_weight_table
note: a custom table with its own identifier is recorded and changes the scores

name: all_judged_certain
note: every weighted dimension judged on both candidates: full coverage, no uncertainty, no alternatives

name: alternatives_rank1_uncertain
note: rank 1 is uncertain, so the next up to three ranked IDs are offered

name: alternatives_fewer_than_four
note: two ranked candidates with an uncertain rank 1: only the next ID is offered

name: alternatives_none_ranked
note: no candidate has any usable evidence: all unscored, no alternatives

name: confidence_low
note: the judgment confidence is 0.0: scores and order are untouched, uncertainty follows the threshold

name: confidence_high
note: the same inputs with the judgment confidence at 1.0: identical scores, order and alternatives

name: disagreement_frequency
note: an excellent frequency judgment on a candidate whose bands compete in the low band

name: empty_baseline
note: no candidates at all: valid, finite and documented

name: single_candidate_no_evidence
note: one candidate with no evidence at all falls back to the baseline

name: single_jev_dimension
note: a candidate whose only evidence is one Jev dimension is still ranked
